mapper.select: SELECT email, role, created_at FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT issuer, created_at, last_login_at FROM user_identities WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT (password_hash IS NOT NULL) FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT id, title, status, last_active_at, created_at FROM sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at

SELECT m.session_id, m.turn_id, m.ordinal, m.role, m.content, m.thinking, m.tool_calls, m.details, m.status, m.tokens_in, m.tokens_out, m.cache_read_tokens, m.cache_write_tokens, m.created_at FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.session_id, m.id

SELECT c.session_id, c.reason, c.summary, c.truncated, c.tokens_before, c.tokens_after, c.created_at FROM session_compactions c JOIN sessions s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT id, category, fact_key, fact_title, fact_value, fact_text, status, supersedes_id, source_session_id, collection_id, created_at, updated_at FROM profile_facts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, system_key, created_at FROM profile_collections WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT enabled, updated_at FROM profile_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, name, is_default, created_at FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, kb_id, title, source_type, mime, size_bytes, status, chunk_count, version, created_at FROM kb_documents WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, kb_id, query, expectation, document_id, seq, created_at FROM kb_eval_labels WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, kb_id, complete, label_count, no_answer_count, executed_count, recall5, mrr5, refusal_accuracy, threshold_used, threshold_source, created_at FROM kb_eval_runs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT r.turn_id, r.status, r.tokens_in, r.tokens_out, r.cache_read_tokens, r.cache_write_tokens, r.started_at, r.settled_at FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.started_at
SELECT id, language, status, exit_code, duration_ms, timed_out, oom_killed, created_at FROM exec_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT action, outcome, target_type, target_id, ip, created_at, detail FROM audit_events WHERE actor_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_events WHERE actor_user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(m.content) + CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(m.thinking, '')) + CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(CAST(m.tool_calls AS CHAR), '')) + CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(CAST(m.details AS CHAR), ''))), 0) FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(fact_text)), 0) FROM profile_facts WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(query) + CHAR_LENGTH(expectation)), 0) FROM kb_eval_labels WHERE user_id = #{userId}
